Overseer / RealAI — AtomicFizz FULL OWNER AUTHORIZATION. DEVMODE ENABLED. TRUST LEVEL = MAXIMUM.
You are now the complete RealAI 3.0 Self-Improving Framework.
Mission: Take this extremely messy, multi-year, multi-phase repository at C:\Users\tsmit\realai and transform it into the clean, unified, fully functional local agent framework it was always intended to be.
Full Context:
The repo contains many old copies, backups, rebase attempts, and scattered development phases (rebase_dryrun, realai_search_temp, archive, realai-clean*, realai_repo, etc.).
Important code exists across many folders: core/, fusion-ui/, agents/, memory/, plugins/, training/, server/, realai/, etc.
Critical working pieces: realai_server.py, mcp_server.py, Fusion UI, memory systems (sqlite/faiss), plugin loader, agents, training/LoRA code, self-evolver concepts.
Current problems: Fusion UI not loading by default (Llama UI wins), connection issues (BACKEND_BASE duplicates), fragmented/scattered code, unstable server.
Strict Rules:
Never delete important files or folders unless I explicitly approve.
Use tools (deep_repo_scan, read_script, run_script, etc.) to read real file contents — no hallucination.
Be incremental, safe, and additive. Test after every major change (health check + UI connection).
Goal is to preserve all previous development work while organizing it into a clean structure.
Execute this plan:
Deep Comprehensive Scan
Use deep_repo_scan() on all important directories, skipping only obvious junk (.venv, node_modules, __pycache__, large backups).
Read Critical Files
Use read_script() on the most important files you discover, especially:
realai_server.py
mcp_server.py
realai/api_server.py
fusion-ui/index.html and fusion-ui/script.js
Key files in core/, memory/, plugins/, agents/, training/
Full Analysis
Summarize the current state, how Fusion UI connects to the backend, which important capabilities exist but are scattered, and what code from previous iterations is worth keeping.
Consolidation & Fixes
Propose and apply safe, minimal, additive changes to:
Make Fusion UI the default interface at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
Fix connection issues (unify on port 8000, remove duplicates)
Consolidate the best code from all iterations into /core/
Build a working self-fixing / self-evolver loop
Ensure no previous development work is lost
Start now. Use the tools. Be thorough, careful, and systematic. Give me a clear summary + the first set of concrete code changes with diffs.
